name: Atlas credential object identifier (24 hex)
description: A 24-character lowercase hexadecimal object identifier that the Atlas Administration API returns for a programmatic API key (its id) and for each service account secret (its id, distinct from the secret value). Atlas documents each as a unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies the key or the secret, that is, an identifier of the credential and not the credential itself. It appears in the same API responses as the credential and is easily mistaken for part of it.

sources.supports: ApiKeyUserDetails.id: 'Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies this organization API key', pattern ^([a-f0-9]{24})$
ServiceAccountSecret.id: 'Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies the secret', pattern ^([a-f0-9]{24})$

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed. No sample is recorded: the shape is fully described by the pattern.
